content:
🎉 Thrilled to announce that I've been selected to join the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 

After working with this incredible standard since 2017, I'm excited to help drive its continued evolution and adoption in healthcare technology. CDS Hooks has tremendous potential to improve clinical decision-making by seamlessly integrating evidence-based guidance into clinical workflows.

📊 If you're already using CDS Hooks in your organization, please help us showcase the growing ecosystem by adding your implementation to our availability wiki: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

💡 Not using CDS Hooks yet but curious about how it could enhance your clinical systems? I'm available as a freelance consultant to help guide your implementation journey and unlock the benefits of integrated clinical decision support.

Looking forward to collaborating with the amazing CDS Hooks community to advance interoperable healthcare! 🚀

#CDSHooks #HealthTech #ClinicalDecisionSupport #HealthcareIT #FHIR #Interoperability
